architectureDecisions: D1 — New module packages/oracle/src/context-budget.js exporting defineContextBudgetProfile, deriveRequirementBudget, deriveNextStepBudget and measureTokens.

D2 — CONTEXT_BUDGET_PROFILE_V1 = {kind, version, modelProfileRef, renderedCharCeiling, reservedChars, blockEnvelopeChars, maxItems, maxProviderCalls, maxResolutionSteps, tokenizer:{id, version}|null}; all counters positive safe integers; profileId = sha256(canonical(profile)).

D3 — deriveRequirementBudget(profile) = {maxItems, maxProviderCalls, maxResolutionSteps, maxMaterializedBytes: renderedCharCeiling - reservedChars - blockEnvelopeChars}; non-positive result is rejected. Because materialization bytes are Buffer.byteLength(canonical(items)) and UTF-8 byte length >= UTF-16 code-unit length, a projection that renders the canonical items renders at most maxMaterializedBytes characters plus envelope.

D4 — blockEnvelopeChars is measured, not guessed: the render-fit test renders an empty-items block through Core renderAgentContext with the profile's context policy and records its length; the profile must declare a value >= the measured envelope.
D5 — deriveNextStepBudget(profile, previousResolution) returns the remaining per-counter budget for BB-092 resolveNext and rejects when any counter is exhausted.

D6 — measureTokens(text, tokenizer) calls an injected countTokens only when profile.tokenizer is declared and the injected implementation reports the same {id, version}; otherwise returns {tokens: null, status: UNKNOWN}. Token results are operational diagnostics outside resolution identity.
D7 — Overflow keeps BB-087 facade semantics: over-budget evidence becomes BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and whole items are dropped; the profile layer adds no truncation path.
D8 — Evidence basis: BB-061 deferred token budgets because tokenization is model-specific; Core renderAgentContext enforces maxSerializedChars (default 32,768) independently of Oracle byte budgets.
implementationSlices: U1 — Profile + derivation [BU1]: implement D1-D3, D5-D6 with unit tests for validation, profileId determinism, derivation, next-step remaining budget and UNKNOWN tokens.

U2 — Render-fit proof [BU2]: test/oracle-budget-render-fit.test.mjs measures the Core envelope (D4), resolves fixtures with ASCII, quotes/newlines, BMP and astral Unicode content at the derived budget and asserts the Core-rendered block length <= renderedCharCeiling for every fixture.

U3 — Identity preservation + Living truth [BU3]: test an over-budget requirement drops whole items via BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with content byte-identical in kept items; add docs/living/system/oracle/context-budget.md; run test:oracle and npm run verify.

negativeVerificationCases: A profile with non-positive counters or a derived maxMaterializedBytes <= 0 is rejected.

Any fixture whose Core-rendered block exceeds renderedCharCeiling at the derived budget fails.
